PyLadder · redesign proposal · calm workspace

Same IDE feel, a lot less on screen

This is a static mockup, not the app. It shows how the home screen and a coding question would look after decluttering. Scroll sideways inside a frame on a small screen.

  • Home shows three things: Continue, the mid-sem test, and your topic ladder.
  • Tiles show a name and a progress bar. Lock reasons move into a tooltip.
  • A question shows only the prompt, the editor and one yellow button until you need more.
  • Hints sit behind one button. The Tests and Output panel stays folded until there is something to show.
